FACT: every value in `_capture.tooling` was probed in this container during this capture (python3/curl/jq/gh/git/os_release) rather than carried forward from any prior report, and nothing was installed in order to perform the capture.

FACT: every captured body is stored verbatim as returned by the API — no field was pruned or truncated, no markdown was re-rendered, no HTML was stripped and no whitespace was normalized.

INFERENCE: corroboration therefore used the payload retrieved directly under the top-level `issue` key instead, reasoning that it comes from the same upstream endpoint family that the issue list is itself captured from, carries the same number/title/labels/state fields, and additionally settles by the presence or absence of a `pull_request` key whether #53 is an issue or a pull request.

FACT: the retrieved issue payload reports locked=true with active_lock_reason=null, consistent with openmainframeproject/cobol-check being archived and read-only.
FACT: the retrieved title and labels quoted above are consistent with the carried-forward characterization of #53 as localization work.

FACT: `review_rules` returns exactly "No user rules provided.", so no user-specified rule governs this artifact; it was produced to enterprise-standard best practice instead, and the absence of rules was not treated as licence to lower the bar.
